ex.t: Angela是一位有28年经验的太极拳____（教练），她说，成功的一小时太极，就是没有任何消极念头的一小时。

ex.s: When reading texts of several hundred words or more, learning is generally more successful when it’s on paper than onscreen.
ex.t: 阅读几百词或更长的文本时，在纸上学习通常比在屏幕上更成功。

ex.s: At 23, I applied for my first job and it was not successful.
ex.t: 在大学学习了农业、医学和渔业后，约翰回到大自然中去观察和提问。

ex.s: How can people be successful in old age according to the author’s grandmother? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 根据作者祖母的说法，人们如何才能在老年活得精彩？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: Students who successfully complete the programme will receive one credit each.
ex.t: 成功完成该项目的学生将各获得一个学分。

ex.s: Becoming a successful painter calls for being resolute.
ex.t: 成为一名成功的画家需要果断。

ex.s: “They get outside,” she says, “and they feel successful.”
ex.t: “他们走到户外，”她说，“而且他们感到自己很有成就感。”

ex.s: Today, there are about 2,000 or more grizzly bears in the US Their recovery has been so successful that the US Fish and Wildlife Service has twice attempted to delist grizzlies, which would loosen legal protections and allow them to be hunted.
ex.t: 如今，美国大约有2000头或更多的灰熊。它们的种群恢复非常成功，以至于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局曾两次试图将灰熊移出名录，而这会放松法律保护并允许猎杀它们。

ex.s: The successful comeback of grizzlies.
ex.t: 生物学家的呼声。

ex.s: What is the key to successful landscape photography according to the author?
ex.t: 根据作者的说法，成功的风景摄影的关键是什么？

ex.s: After successfully completing the 4-Week Learning Sprint, you will need to submit a plan for a sport﹣based project, which you will work on if selected as an IOC Young Leader.
ex.t: 成功完成四周学习冲刺后，你需要提交一个基于体育项目的计划，如果被选为IOC青年领袖，你将开展这个项目。

ex.s: •You have successfully completed the 4-Week Learning Sprint.
ex.t: •你已经成功完成了四周学习冲刺。

ex.s: Little wonder the Federal Duck Stamp Program has been called one of the most successful conservation programs ever initiated.
ex.t: 北美水禽数量下降的原因是什么？

ex.s: A successful swap depends on the selection of clothes, the organization of the event, and, obviously, how much fun is had.
ex.t: 这里有一些建议。

ex.s: However, becoming a full-time, successful actor would still be an uphill battle for another eight years until he landed a number of film roles that finally got him noticed.
ex.t: 尼尔森总觉得他应该演喜剧但他英俊的外表和独特的嗓音让他忙于正剧角色。

ex.s: He built a hugely successful career with little more than plain old hard work and determination.
ex.t: 尼尔森为什么想当演员？

ex.s: He became a successful comedy actor.
ex.t: 艺术长人生短。

ex.s: "Instead, our results suggest that the successful dogs realized that a smiling mouth means the same thing as smiling eyes, and the same rule applies to an angry mouth having the same meaning as angry eyes.”
ex.t: 此时还不清楚狗为什么似乎具备识别人类不同面部表情的能力。

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织经理审核并将保存在我们的数据库中六个月．我们不回复每位候选人．如果入选你将由经理联系．如果在六个月内没有收到任何更新这意味着你的申请未获成功．

ex.s: Even the most successful public speaker will make mistakes.
ex.t: 即使最成功的演讲者也会犯错。

ex.s: They successfully lost weight.
ex.t: 他们的新陈代谢率较慢。

ex.s: “The key to successful small talk is learning how to connect with others, not just communicate with them.”
ex.t: "成功闲聊的关键是学会如何与他人建立联系，而不仅仅是与他们交流。"

ex.s: What is important for successful small talk according to Carducci?
ex.t: 根据卡杜奇的观点，成功闲聊最重要的是什么？

ex.s: Moreover, the USA has a track record of successfully accepting immigrants.
ex.t: 此外，美国有成功接受移民的历史记录。

ex.s: do anything successfully with given orders
ex.t: 它会因为人类的干预而恶化。

ex.s: This is something that even the highly successful Harry Potter movies can’t escape from, with fans of the books disappointed not to see some of their favourite characters in the movie versions.
ex.t: 这是连极其成功的《哈利·波特》电影也无法回避的——书迷们因在电影版中没看到一些最喜爱的角色而感到失望。

ex.s: Bill Shankly(1913-1981) was one of Britain's most successful and respected football managers.
ex.t: 比尔·尚克利（1913—1981）是英国最成功、最受尊敬的足球教练之一。

ex.s: Apart from being a successful statesman, he was also well known as a leading American author, printer and publisher, successful diplomat, creative scientist and inventor.
ex.t: 除了是成功的政治家，他还以杰出的美国作家、印刷商和出版商、成功的外交家、富有创造力的科学家和发明家而著称。

ex.s: Many people, including his high school teammates and coaches, thought Stephen was too short, too thin and too weak to have a basketball career as successful as his father’s.
ex.t: 许多人，包括他高中时的队友和教练，都认为斯蒂芬太矮、太瘦、太弱，不可能拥有像他父亲那样成功的篮球生涯。

defs.def: having become popular and/or made a lot of money 获得成功的；有成就的

ex.s: One day after I made us coffee, I asked her: “What’s the secret to being successful in your 90s? ”
ex.t: 有一天我给我们俩煮了咖啡后问她："九十多岁还活得精彩的秘诀是什么？"

ex.s: is good at handling pressureB. works hard to become successful
ex.t: 擅长处理压力B. 努力工作以求成功

ex.s: “If we're successful,” their mission statement reads, “we believe this will be one of the most important and widely beneficial scientific advances ever made.”
ex.t: "如果我们成功的话，"他们的使命声明写道，"我们相信这将是迄今为止最重要、最有益的科学进步之一。"

ex.s: Everyone knows that success rarely happens overnight, but perhaps not many know that a lot of highly successful writers have previously faced rejection.
ex.t: 人人都知道成功很少是一蹴而就的，但或许很少有人知道，许多极其成功的作家都曾遭遇过退稿。
